name: Gold
overview: Scripture reveals gold as a precious and highly valued resource, originating from notable regions such as Havilah, where its quality is distinguished (Genesis 2:11-12). It was commonly fashioned into jewelry and ornaments, as seen in the golden earring and bracelets given as gifts (Genesis 24:22), and was also part of the spoils taken from Egypt, symbolizing wealth and divine provision (Exodus 3:22; 11:2). The biblical narrative underscores gold's role not only in personal adornment but also in the broader cultural and covenantal life of God's people.
